question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

It is the teacher’s ______ to decide who will participate in the competition.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. 'right.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is talking about the teacher having the authority to take decisions on who should participate in the competition or not.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'right.'
 
• According to the context, the word 'right' means 'If you are within your rights to do something, you are legally allowed to do it.'
 
• Example:
 
 
• *The public has the **right** to protest against the corrupt government.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 

Complete Sentence:__ *It is the teacher’s __**right**__ to decide who will participate in the competition.*
